fix: Move `actions` into exactly one place instead of cloning. Before `let mut column = vec![...]`, replace the `if single_line { row.push(actions.clone()); }` block with `let below_actions = if single_line { row.push(actions); None } else { Some(Widget::from(incular_widgets::Align::new(incular_widgets::Alignment::CENTER_RIGHT, actions))) };`, then remove the later `if !single_line { column.push(...) }` block and insert `column.extend(below_actions);` right after the row widget is pushed into `column`, before the divider push. Separate `if` blocks cannot be used for this because the borrow checker does not correlate the two conditions.
